title: The integral system compositor is the varying-ring compositor
statement: For a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and composable scheme morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z in universe u, specialize the varying-ring operations to R_n=ULift(O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1))) with the actual adjacent quotient transitions. The section-normalized integralComparisonSystemComposition(ell,E,f,g) equals the varying-ring derived pullback compositor gComp(R,transition,f,g). This is equality of the specified natural isomorphisms on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of whole strict systems.

source.place: Tags 0D6D and 03D3; Zheng 4.10, ordinary composition and its exact descent.

proof.text: The two ordinary direct-image functors and their chosen adjunctions agree definitionally at the lifted quotient rings. The varying-ring modulePComp satisfies precisely the section formula in integralComparisonSequenceComposition_existsUnique.

The Mathlib identity conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointCompIso_inv identifies the conjugate of moduleGComp with modulePComp. Thus moduleGComp satisfies the complete uniquely normalized specification of integralComparisonSequenceComposition. Apply uniqueness to equate the ordinary pullback compositors.

Unfold the two derived compositors, rewrite by the ordinary equality, and identify their standard exact-composition localization maps by definitional equality. This proves the equality of natural isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Complete proof by section-normalized uniqueness, conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointCompIso_inv, and exact localization.

theorem integralComparisonSystemComposition_eq_varyingRing
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    integralComparisonSystemComposition l E f g =
      ProEtale.VaryingRing.gComp
        (fun n ↦ CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))
        (fun n ↦ CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1)).ulift) f g
